tasks.short: Collect cash, prepare invoices and settle concession accounts

steps.what: Collect coins and bills, count proceeds and verify machine and concession account details
Calculate account shares and prepare invoices from the verified collection input
Check invoices, resolve collection differences and settle accounts with concessionaires

tasks.design: Keep physical collection, counting and concessionaire settlement with the servicer. Configure native {ERP} invoice and share calculations from verified {OPS_SYSTEM} entries and agreement terms in {DOCS}; telemetry is optional source evidence rather than an assumed cash truth.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified counts and contract terms are repeatedly recalculated and copied into invoices.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit collection amounts and share rules support deterministic billing arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Physical count differences, disputed terms and timing differences require explanation.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize an unresolved discrepancy and agree an accurate settlement without hiding it in a calculation.
tasks.altitude: Reduce invoice preparation arithmetic while retaining cash handling and settlement responsibility.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of mechanics, installers and repairers
reach.learn: How collection evidence relates to a contract settlement

evidence.claim: The digest describes cash and transaction integration as an E1 deterministic pattern; local collection and settlement savings are not measured.
The Cantaloupe vending case concerns routing and fills per visit; its result is not used as invoice or physical counting savings.

assumptions: Boundary is servicer collection, invoice preparation and settlement; exclude travel, concessionaire work and back-office bookkeeping. Settlement occurs only within delegated financial authority.

The servicer physically collects and counts in s1 and captures machine/site ID, collection period, denomination counts or counted totals, currency, refunds/adjustments and source references. Existing account owners supply the signed concession agreement before s1; the servicer captures recipient, applicable share/rate, billing period and existing tax treatment there. The 45 hours include all capture and verification; no free structured count, discrepancy code or valid-rate flag is assumed. Missing terms or inconsistent counts use manual reconciliation.

Concessionaires supply responses after seeing the proposed settlement during s3, before the final settlement record; conversation time remains counted. Native invoice templates and fixed calculations precede custom code; no new telemetry feed is assumed.
unknowns: Actual contract formulas, tax treatment and settlement authority
Existing invoice automation and manual preparation share
research_questions: How much invoice effort remains after physical counting, agreement capture and dispute handling?

already_counted.description: Physical collection, counting and billing input capture
Invoice acceptance, differences and concessionaire settlement

incremental.description: Contract calculation maintenance and failed invoice handling

approvals.approved_version: Exact concessionaire, machine/period, counts, rates, adjustments, invoice amount/currency and settlement terms communicated; any changed item requires renewed authorized acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=75, gross=25, focal upkeep=7, net=18. Range 0-6 allows existing automatic invoices, physical counting time and disputed concessions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange major repair support or machine removal

steps.what: Contact repair personnel and arrange machine removal when major repairs require it

tasks.design: Retain direct coordination with repair personnel and the site, using existing {OPS_SYSTEM} records and {TELEPHONY}. A routing rule cannot establish transport feasibility, acceptance or the right repair arrangement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Major repairs create case-specific coordination and access questions.
tasks.enabler_now: The task establishes no separate repetitive message-copying share to automate.
tasks.still_hard: Repair capacity, site access and removal conditions need reciprocal clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the actual problem and recognize when logistics or repair expertise is missing.
tasks.altitude: Repair coordination retains its full time.

reach.task: Clarify the scope of a major repair referral
reach.learn: Which fault and access details affect repair arrangements

evidence.claim: Major repair and removal arrangements depend on case-specific communication; no local time saving is established by work-order access alone.

assumptions: Boundary is contacting and arranging, excluding original diagnosis, physical removal and repair. No supplier labour is counted as a servicer saving.

Existing diagnosis supplies the fault context before contact; repair personnel and site contacts supply capacity, access and acceptance during s1 before the arrangement closes. Clarification and existing recording remain counted. No free major-repair, safe-removal or confirmed-capacity flag is assumed; unresolved conditions stay open.
Use native contact records and current communication first. No extra reporting requirement, new tool or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual removal authority and repair logistics constraints
research_questions: Which arrangements require direct repair or transport expertise before confirmation?

already_counted.description: Repair contact, logistics clarification and arrangement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Case-specific coordination retains its time; no supplier work is shifted into the claimed saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Find and interpret manuals and wiring diagrams

steps.what: Identify the machine version and capture the information question for manuals and wiring diagrams
Retrieve matching manual versions and wiring diagram pages through native document search
Read original manuals and wiring diagrams, verify applicability and gather needed repair information

tasks.design: Configure native indexing and search in {DOCS} to retrieve original manufacturer pages from a verified machine/version question. The servicer reads the original diagrams and establishes applicability; the search returns candidates rather than repair instructions or a diagnosis.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding a known machine's correct manual pages can involve repeated browsing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing searchable documents and explicit version metadata permit deterministic retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Similar models, undocumented modifications and ambiguous diagrams require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when the retrieved document does not match the actual machine.
tasks.altitude: Reduce browsing while retaining technical reading and applicability checks.

reach.role: electrical and electronics repairer, commercial and industrial equipment
reach.learn: How model and revision differences affect technical references

evidence.claim: Native document indexing and model/version filtering can retrieve original pages without a model; local compatibility and savings are unmeasured E1.

assumptions: Boundary is information retrieval and interpretation, excluding diagnosis, repair execution and creation of manufacturer instructions. This design provides no wiring or repair procedure.

Manufacturers supply available manuals and version identifiers before s1. The servicer captures actual model/serial and relevant revision markings, document identifiers and the information question in s1, including physical identification and manual entry within its 20 hours. Repository setup maps only existing publisher metadata, with support effort counted below. No free correct-manual or structured-fault flag is assumed; scans without reliable search or ambiguous versions use manual browsing and clarification.
Native full-text search and bookmarks precede custom indexing. S3 checks original page context; no model-generated diagram interpretation or automatic repair action is proposed.
unknowns: Searchable document coverage and reliable revision identification
research_questions: How much browsing time remains after machine identification and original diagram reading are included?
